summary: Frontend UI testing for Admin theme switching, Create User form improvements, and Login page verification. All 16 test cases PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Console warning about Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended
Minor: HTML hydration warning about <tr> inside <span> in tbody - React rendering issue in user table
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified working: 1) Login page pull cord reveals form, lamp goes left, form slides from right. 2) No moving particles - stars are static. 3) 'Saurabh Jangir' branding and 'CAPEX Procurement Portal' title visible. 4) Admin login works with admin@capex.com/admin123. 5) Admin dashboard has 5 stat cards. 6) Themes tab shows 'Admin Panel Theme' title with correct description. 7) Theme switching works - background changes from rgb(240, 249, 255) to rgb(255, 251, 235) when selecting Sunset Glow. 8) Users tab has all expected columns. 9) Add User form is professional with labeled sections (PERSONAL INFORMATION, ACCOUNT SETUP, LOCATION ASSIGNMENT), icons, two-column grid layout. 10) Conditional sections appear based on role. 11) Emergent badge NOT visible anywhere.
